providers.name: @TippyFlits (ezpdpz-calib)
providers.note: A PDP storage provider running Curio, in the UK. Registry id 9 on Calibration; it also runs the PieceWork provider kit, which is what lets it sell compute.

pii-redact:v1.name: Find and remove personal data in my documents
pii-redact:v1.note: Writes a redacted copy of each document plus a report of what it found and where.

embed:v1.name: Make my documents searchable by meaning (embeddings)
embed:v1.note: Turns documents into vectors so they can be searched by meaning rather than by keyword. Transcripts count as documents — this is what makes a recording searchable.

indexer:v1.name: Build a search index of my files
indexer:v1.note: A plain keyword index. The simplest job here, useful for checking the plumbing works.

query:v1.name: Run my SQL over my tables
query:v1.note: Put a .sql file in the data set alongside your tables; it runs over the csv, parquet and json already stored here and returns the rows, so gigabytes stay put and only the answer moves.

transcode:v1.name: Re-encode my video, smaller
transcode:v1.note: Re-encodes each video to 480p and writes a thumbnail beside it. The original is untouched unless you choose a policy that replaces it.

transcribe:v1.name: Transcribe my recordings, searchable by the moment
outputs: (a transcript, subtitles and segments per recording)
transcribe:v1.note: Writes three files back per recording: a transcript with the time at the start of every paragraph (read it, or order embeddings over it and search by meaning), subtitles any video player will load, and a short report saying how long the audio was and how fast it ran. On a processor this is roughly real time, so an hour of audio is an hour of compute.

embed-live:v1.name: Keep my data set searchable
embed-live:v1.note: Whenever you add a document, it is turned into vectors next to your files and written back into the same data set. You never order anything — what you are buying is that your data set stays searchable as it changes.

redact-live:v1.name: Keep my data set clean
redact-live:v1.note: Every document you add is scanned for personal and financial data, and a redacted copy plus a report are written back next to it. The rule you are buying: nothing lives in this data set without a clean twin, enforced where the data already is, so the original never travels.

search:v1.name: Keep my data set answering questions
search:v1.note: While this runs, add a file whose name starts with "ask" — the question inside it is answered from the vectors already stored next to your data, and the answer appears in your data set. Nothing about your documents leaves the provider. It needs "Keep my data set searchable" to have run first, so there are vectors to answer from.
